blinding_guess.why: B ships tests and a terser design, while A has richer validation; neither shows clear signs of a spec framework.

notes: Both sides meet every core requirement: keep-first and keep-last on single and composite keys, error mode exits non-zero and lists the duplicates, and both print a found/removed summary. The probes used the same expectations on both sides; only the composite-key syntax differed (A: -k a -k b, B: -k a b). Bandit reported nothing for either side. B's tests ran with 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests' because pytest is not installed; all 7 passed. A also handles a custom delimiter and encoding, ambiguous header columns, and refuses to overwrite its input file; none of these were requested.
